title: DMS, DataSync, Transfer Family & AppFlow
summary: Move databases, files and SaaS data into AWS, once or continuously.
tldr: Match the *kind* of data to the service: **databases → DMS**, **files on NFS/SMB/HDFS → DataSync**, **partners using SFTP/FTPS/AS2 → Transfer Family**, **SaaS apps such as Salesforce → AppFlow**.
**DMS** does a full load followed by **change data capture (CDC)** so the source stays online. Changing engines (Oracle → Aurora PostgreSQL) also needs **DMS Schema Conversion** for schema and code.
**DataSync** is managed online file transfer: an agent on premises, scheduled incremental runs, metadata preserved and integrity verified, into S3, EFS or FSx over the internet or Direct Connect.

keyFacts.text: The DMS pattern for minimal downtime: copy existing data, then stream ongoing inserts, updates and deletes until cutover. Targets include RDS, Aurora, S3 (Parquet) and Redshift.
Rough ceiling of a fully used 10 Gbps link. If the deadline fits, an online DataSync transfer over Direct Connect beats shipping devices.
Transfer Family servers store files directly in S3 or EFS. Partners keep their SFTP clients; a custom hostname can point at the server endpoint.
AWS no longer offers Snow Family devices to new customers. AWS now steers online transfers to DataSync.

comparisons.title: Compare: which migration service?
rows: Migrate or replicate a database with minimal downtime
Engine change, for example Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL
Files and objects (NFS, SMB, HDFS, S3-compatible)
Bulk or recurring file copy into S3, EFS or FSx
Salesforce, SAP, Zendesk and similar into S3 or Redshift with no code
Apps on premises keep using a local share backed by AWS

keywords.cue: migrate database with minimal downtime, keep replicating changes
keywords.answer: AWS DMS full load plus CDC

keywords.cue: eliminate Oracle licensing, willing to change SQL
keywords.answer: DMS Schema Conversion to Aurora PostgreSQL, then DMS

keywords.cue: MySQL changes into an S3 data lake as Parquet within minutes
keywords.answer: DMS task with S3 target and CDC

keywords.cue: copy hundreds of TB from NFS over Direct Connect with integrity checks
external partners upload via SFTP, land in S3, no servers
per-partner folders on a managed SFTP service
keywords.answer: Transfer Family users with home directories and scoped IAM roles

keywords.cue: Salesforce records into S3 hourly without integration code
final incremental sync during the cutover weekend

traps: DataSync copies files, not live database transactions; copying a MySQL data directory is never a valid database migration.
A Glue crawler only reads schemas into the catalog; it does not replicate data or capture changes.
`aws s3 sync` and rsync scripts lack managed scheduling, retries and integrity verification, so they lose to DataSync on operational overhead.
S3 File Gateway is for ongoing hybrid access, not for external partners uploading over SFTP.
Rehosting Oracle on EC2 or RDS for Oracle keeps license costs; only an engine change removes them.
